# Shared Studio

> Shared brand, interface and production guidance with working examples and downloadable references.

## Production guides

- [Stage video production](https://brand.getshared.ai/artifacts/video.md): Framing, motion warnings, quiet idle, active-listening timing, neutral motion for lip sync, export checks and media downloads.

## Design reference

- [Shared Studio design reference](https://brand.getshared.ai/DESIGN.md): Design tokens and guidance across the Studio.
